mapper.sql: id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, embedding_model_id, model_version, index_version, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_retry_at, locked_at, started_at, completed_at, error_code, error_message, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: insert into knowledge_index_task (knowledge_base_id, document_id, embedding_model_id, model_version, index_version, max_attempts) values (#{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentId}, #{embeddingModelId}, #{modelVersion}, #{indexVersion}, #{maxAttempts}) returning id

with candidate as ( select id from knowledge_index_task where status = 'PENDING' and next_retry_at <= current_timestamp and attempt_count < max_attempts order by id for update skip locked limit 1 ) update knowledge_index_task task set status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = task.attempt_count + 1, locked_at = current_timestamp, started_at = current_timestamp, update_time = current_timestamp from candidate where task.id = candidate.id returning task.id, task.knowledge_base_id, task.document_id, task.embedding_model_id, task.model_version, task.index_version, task.status, task.attempt_count, task.max_attempts, task.next_retry_at, task.locked_at, task.started_at, task.completed_at, task.error_code, task.error_message, task.create_time, task.update_time
mapper.update: update knowledge_index_task set status = 'SUCCESS', completed_at = current_timestamp, locked_at = null, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING'

update knowledge_index_task set status = case when attempt_count < max_attempts then 'PENDING' else 'FAILED' end, next_retry_at = current_timestamp + interval '30 seconds', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, locked_at = null, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING'

update knowledge_index_task set status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, locked_at = null, completed_at = current_timestamp, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING'

update knowledge_index_task set status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, next_retry_at = current_timestamp, locked_at = null, started_at = null, completed_at = null, error_code = null, error_message = null, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{taskId} and status = 'FAILED'

update knowledge_index_task set status = 'PENDING', locked_at = null, next_retry_at = current_timestamp, error_code = 'KNOWLEDGE_TASK_RECOVERED', error_message = 'Recovered after worker restart', update_time = current_timestamp where status = 'RUNNING' and locked_at < #{lockedBefore} and attempt_count < max_attempts
mapper.select: select from knowledge_index_task where document_id = #{documentId} and status = 'FAILED' order by id desc limit 1
